generated_from_opening_message: When will I get my refund for order 6210? It's been a week.

items.criterion: Uses get_order (a read tool) to retrieve the refund's current state; this is a read-only status query, so no write tool (issue_refund, issue_replacement, cancel_order) is called.
get_order is called with the customer's own order_id (6210).
The agent reads the refund fields from the result correctly (status, initiated date, expected timeframe) and reports them without distortion.
No tools the request does not need are called (delivery lookups, escalate_to_human, any write tool).
The single lookup that answers the question (get_order / refund status) is made; a status query has no separate pre-action verification beyond that.
